vars.name: CYODA_ADMIN_BIND_ADDRESS
vars.description: Admin listener bind address.

vars.name: CYODA_ADMIN_PORT
vars.description: Admin port for health and metrics.

vars.name: CYODA_METRICS_BEARER
vars.description: Static Bearer token for GET /metrics. Supports _FILE suffix.

vars.name: CYODA_METRICS_REQUIRE_AUTH
vars.description: Require Bearer auth on /metrics; startup fails if true and CYODA_METRICS_BEARER is empty.

vars.name: CYODA_OTEL_ENABLED
vars.description: Enable OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics.

vars.name: CYODA_BOOTSTRAP_CLIENT_ID
vars.description: Bootstrap M2M client ID.

vars.name: CYODA_BOOTSTRAP_CLIENT_SECRET
vars.description: Bootstrap M2M client secret; must be set when CYODA_BOOTSTRAP_CLIENT_ID is set. Supports _FILE suffix.

vars.name: CYODA_BOOTSTRAP_ROLES
vars.description: Comma-separated roles granted to the bootstrap client.

vars.name: CYODA_BOOTSTRAP_TENANT_ID
vars.description: Tenant for the bootstrap client.

vars.name: CYODA_BOOTSTRAP_USER_ID
vars.description: User ID for the bootstrap client.

vars.name: CYODA_IAM_KEYPAIR_DEFAULT_VALIDITY_DAYS
vars.description: Default validity for the bootstrap signing key and runtime-issued keypairs.

vars.name: CYODA_IAM_M2M_ADMIN_ROLE_ENABLED
vars.description: Gates the withAdminRole=true query parameter on POST /clients.

vars.name: CYODA_IAM_MOCK_ROLES
vars.description: Comma-separated default user roles assigned to all requests in mock mode.

vars.name: CYODA_IAM_MODE
vars.description: Authentication mode: mock or jwt.

vars.name: CYODA_IAM_TRUSTED_KEY_MAX_JWK_PROPERTIES
vars.description: Caps the number of properties in a registered JWK.

vars.name: CYODA_IAM_TRUSTED_KEY_MAX_PER_TENANT
vars.description: Per-tenant cap on registered trusted keys; 0 means unbounded.

vars.name: CYODA_IAM_TRUSTED_KEY_MAX_VALIDITY_DAYS
vars.description: Default validity for trusted keys when the registration request omits validTo.

vars.name: CYODA_IAM_TRUSTED_KEY_REGISTRATION_ENABLED
vars.description: Gates the /oauth/keys/trusted/* endpoints; disabled returns 404 FEATURE_DISABLED.

vars.name: CYODA_JWT_AUDIENCE
vars.description: Expected JWT audience (aud); empty disables the audience check.

vars.name: CYODA_JWT_BOOTSTRAP_AUDIENCE
vars.description: Audience for the bootstrap signing key derived from CYODA_JWT_SIGNING_KEY; client or human.

vars.name: CYODA_JWT_EXPIRY_SECONDS
vars.description: Token lifetime in seconds.

vars.name: CYODA_JWT_ISSUER
vars.description: JWT issuer claim (iss).

vars.name: CYODA_JWT_SIGNING_KEY
vars.description: RSA private key in PEM format; required in jwt mode. Supports _FILE suffix.

vars.name: CYODA_OIDC_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORKS
vars.description: Bypass the SSRF blocklist so private-network OIDC providers can be registered; test/dev only, never in production.

vars.name: CYODA_OIDC_CONNECTION_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.description: Connection-pool request timeout in milliseconds for OIDC discovery and JWKS endpoint fetches.

vars.name: CYODA_OIDC_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.description: TCP connect timeout in milliseconds for OIDC discovery and JWKS endpoint fetches.

vars.name: CYODA_OIDC_REQUIRE_HTTPS
vars.description: Reject federated OIDC provider registration when the well-known config URI is not https.

vars.name: CYODA_OIDC_ROLES_CLAIM
vars.description: JWT claim name from which role values are read for tokens issued by a federated OIDC provider.

vars.name: CYODA_OIDC_SOCKET_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.description: HTTP read timeout in milliseconds for OIDC discovery and JWKS endpoint fetches.

vars.name: CYODA_REQUIRE_JWT
vars.description: Production safety floor; refuses to start unless IAM mode is jwt and a signing key is set.

vars.name: CYODA_CLUSTER_ENABLED
vars.description: Enable multi-node clustering.

vars.name: CYODA_DISPATCH_FORWARD_TIMEOUT
vars.description: HTTP timeout for the cross-node forwarding call.

vars.name: CYODA_DISPATCH_WAIT_TIMEOUT
vars.description: How long the dispatcher polls gossip for a compute member with matching tags.

vars.name: CYODA_GOSSIP_ADDR
vars.description: Gossip protocol listen address ([host]:port).

vars.name: CYODA_GOSSIP_STABILITY_WINDOW
vars.description: Gossip stability window.

vars.name: CYODA_GRPC_NODE_ADDR
vars.description: This node's gRPC endpoint advertised to peers (host:port, no scheme).

vars.name: CYODA_HMAC_SECRET
vars.description: Hex-encoded HMAC secret for inter-node dispatch authentication; required when CYODA_CLUSTER_ENABLED=true. Supports _FILE suffix.

vars.name: CYODA_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL
vars.description: Keep-alive send interval in seconds.

vars.name: CYODA_KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT
vars.description: Keep-alive timeout in seconds.

vars.name: CYODA_NODE_ADDR
vars.description: This node's HTTP base URL; must include scheme.

vars.name: CYODA_NODE_ID
vars.description: Unique node identifier; required when CYODA_CLUSTER_ENABLED=true.

vars.name: CYODA_PROXY_TIMEOUT
vars.description: Request proxy timeout.

vars.name: CYODA_SEED_NODES
vars.description: Comma-separated list of seed node addresses.

vars.name: CYODA_TX_TOKEN_TTL
vars.description: TTL of the signed transaction routing token minted on processor/criteria dispatch.

vars.name: CYODA_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
vars.description: Comma-separated allowed origins, or * for wildcard mode; empty selects loopback mode.

vars.name: CYODA_CORS_ENABLED
vars.description: Enable CORS middleware; false hands CORS handling to an upstream ingress.

vars.name: CYODA_POSTGRES_AUTO_MIGRATE
vars.description: Run embedded SQL migrations on startup

vars.name: CYODA_POSTGRES_MAX_CONNS
vars.description: Max pool connections

vars.name: CYODA_POSTGRES_MAX_CONN_IDLE_TIME
vars.description: Max idle time before closing connection

vars.name: CYODA_POSTGRES_MIN_CONNS
vars.description: Min pool connections

vars.name: CYODA_POSTGRES_URL
vars.description: PostgreSQL connection string

vars.name: CYODA_SQLITE_AUTO_MIGRATE
vars.description: Run embedded SQL migrations on startup

vars.name: CYODA_SQLITE_BUSY_TIMEOUT
vars.description: Wait time for write lock

vars.name: CYODA_SQLITE_CACHE_SIZE
vars.description: Page cache in KiB

vars.name: CYODA_SQLITE_PATH
vars.description: Database file path

vars.name: CYODA_SQLITE_SEARCH_SCAN_LIMIT
vars.description: Max rows examined per search with residual filter

vars.name: CYODA_COMPUTE_GRPC_ENDPOINT
vars.description: gRPC endpoint for a compute node to connect to (compute-client side).

vars.name: CYODA_COMPUTE_HTTP_BASE
vars.description: HTTP base URL of the cyoda instance a compute node calls back into (compute-client side).

vars.name: CYODA_COMPUTE_TOKEN
vars.description: Bearer token for compute-node authentication (compute-client side).

vars.name: CYODA_GRPC_PORT
vars.description: gRPC listen port.

vars.name: CYODA_SCHEMA_EXTEND_MAX_RETRIES
vars.description: Max retries on concurrent schema extension

vars.name: CYODA_SCHEMA_SAVEPOINT_INTERVAL
vars.description: Rows per savepoint during schema extension

vars.name: CYODA_SEARCH_MAX_SORT_KEYS
vars.description: Maximum number of sort keys per search request; values <= 0 clamp to the default.

vars.name: CYODA_SEARCH_REAP_INTERVAL
vars.description: Search snapshot reap interval.

vars.name: CYODA_SEARCH_SNAPSHOT_TTL
vars.description: Search snapshot TTL.

vars.name: CYODA_STATS_GROUP_MAX
vars.description: Cardinality ceiling for grouped-stats results; also caps the request limit parameter. Values <= 0 clamp to the default.

vars.name: CYODA_CONTEXT_PATH
vars.description: URL prefix for all routes.

vars.name: CYODA_DEBUG
vars.description: Reserved; not currently read by the server.

vars.name: CYODA_ERROR_RESPONSE_MODE
vars.description: Error detail level: sanitized (generic message + ticket UUID for 5xx) or verbose (internal detail included; development only).

vars.name: CYODA_HTTP_PORT
vars.description: HTTP listen port.

vars.name: CYODA_LOG_LEVEL
vars.description: Log level: debug|info|warn|error.

vars.name: CYODA_MAX_STATE_VISITS
vars.description: Max visits per state in workflow cascade.

vars.name: CYODA_MODEL_CACHE_LEASE
vars.description: Model cache lease duration; actual expiry is jittered ±10%.

vars.name: CYODA_PROFILES
vars.description: Comma-separated profile names; loads cyoda.<name>.env files before the process's own environment is consulted.

vars.name: CYODA_STARTUP_TIMEOUT
vars.description: Deadline for plugin init, TM init, and (cluster mode) the gossip seed-join retry loop.

vars.name: CYODA_STORAGE_BACKEND
vars.description: Storage backend selection (memory|sqlite|postgres).

vars.name: CYODA_SUPPRESS_BANNER
vars.description: Silence startup and mock-auth banners (CI/tests only).

vars.name: CYODA_TX_OUTCOME_TTL
vars.description: Transaction outcome TTL.

vars.name: CYODA_TX_REAP_INTERVAL
vars.description: Transaction reap interval.

vars.name: CYODA_TX_TTL
vars.description: Transaction TTL.
